fields.description: Who this line pays. Must be somebody the paired progress report names.
fields.label: Volunteer

fields.description: The day this line is about. Must fall inside the report's period, and a volunteer may appear only once on a day.
fields.label: Date

fields.description: Whether the volunteer was there that day. An absent day may be recorded, but it cannot carry a stipend.
fields.label: Attended

fields.description: Hours served that day, where your society records them. Reporting only: no stipend is worked out from hours.
fields.label: Hours

fields.description: What this day is worth to this volunteer, in the form's currency. Never negative, and zero on a day they did not attend.
fields.label: Stipend
